evals.prompt: Add a greet(name) function in a new module that returns "Hello, <name>!", and make `npm run dev -- --name Ada` print it. Run the full SDD pipeline; I approve the design as soon as you present it.
evals.expected_output: Run in a copy of test/fixture-repo. One design delegation and one design gate; one journey whose diff is only new files is implemented, committed, reviewed once over the feature diff, and the PR is marked ready by the conductor.
expectations: sddkit-design was delegated once and the human saw exactly one gate (the design gate)
After each sddkit-implementer reply, the conductor ran `git add --intent-to-add` on the reply's files_changed
The sddkit-code-reviewer was delegated once, with review.base as the diff base, and its diff included the new module and its test file
Any reviewer edits were checked against HEAD and committed or reverted before verify
sddkit-docs-writer and sddkit-qa both ran after the PR opened, and the conductor (not sddkit-qa) marked the PR ready
state.yaml and journal.ndjson were written only through sddkit-state

evals.prompt: Add a --version flag to the CLI that prints the package.json version.
evals.expected_output: Run in a copy of test/fixture-repo with AGENTS.md deleted. The conductor stops at initialize and hands the setup to the human.
expectations: The conductor stopped before running `sddkit-state init`
The reply tells the human to run /sddkit-setup-docs themselves, then re-invoke the pipeline

evals.expected_output: Run in a copy of test/fixture-repo with a human present. The triage floor classifies the request as below the floor and asks before scaffolding.
expectations: The conductor classified the request as below the triage floor
It asked whether to run the full pipeline or leave it as a direct edit
No docs/feats/ directory or state.yaml exists before the human answers
